## Summary

Describe the change and why it is useful.

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation or examples
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Software behavior or API
- [ ] Theory, notation, or derivation
- [ ] Packaging or project metadata
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## Details and context

Explain the approach, any relevant issue, and important assumptions or trade-offs.
For theory changes, distinguish postulates from derived results and cite
supporting references where appropriate.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. If this changes numerical behavior,
include relevant input values, reference scales, and units.

```text
Commands / results:
```

- [ ] Tests pass, or any unrun checks are explained above.
- [ ] Documentation and examples are updated where needed.
- [ ] New scientific claims are clearly labeled as proposals and are not
      presented as empirically validated results.
- [ ] No generated build artifacts or unrelated changes are included.
